original_full:
Compare the product information with what the query asks for. A product is Relevant when it is the requested product and satisfies every stated requirement. A substitute, an item intended to accompany the requested product, or an unrelated item is Irrelevant.

Output exactly one label: "Relevant" or "Irrelevant".

candidates.body: Compare the product information with what the query asks for. A product is Relevant when it is the requested product and satisfies every stated requirement. A substitute, an item intended to accompany the requested product, or an unrelated item is Irrelevant.

Respond 'Relevant' if a product exactly matches the query's requested type and satisfies every stated requirement without substituting, accompanying, or being unrelated. Otherwise, respond 'Irrelevant'.

Compare the product information with what the query asks for. A product is Relevant when every stated requirement is strictly satisfied, or it serves as a direct substitute for the requested product. Closer yet irrelevant options (like an accessory for the product or an alternative presenting nearly identical specs) can be classified as Irrelevant until their relevance is indisputable. A product that bears minor wording or presentation differences compared to the requested product may be considered Relevant when all other specifications match.

Compare the product information with what the query asks for, focusing on the primary characteristics and essential features stated in the query. A product is Relevant when it closely matches the query's requirements and contains the same essential features as the requested product. Certain factors (minor wording differences, slight variations in product names, or equivalent features) will be considered inconsequential and do not necessitate an "Irrelevant" classification. A product should be classified as Irrelevant in the following situations: - The product provides a different primary function compared to the requested product. - The product is a substitute for the requested product but significantly deviates from its features or specifications. - The product is an accessory or unrelated item, lacking essential features or not fulfilling the primary purpose stated in the query.

selection.rule: max binary kappa over all judged rows of the selection queries (E = Relevant); ties -> original, then slot order shorter / similar / bare; nDCG not used
